name: context-loop
description: Keep long Codex tasks coherent in one thread and resumable across sessions with repository-backed state, checkpoints, plans, decisions, and optional continuation hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Durable context and focus for long Codex tasks
interface.longDescription: Context Loop stores the goal, execution plan, decisions, blockers, evidence, and next action inside the target repository. Codex checkpoints meaningful progress as it works, can restore the task after context compaction or a new session, and can optionally use trusted project-local hooks to keep an active task moving in the same thread.
defaultPrompt: $context-loop start a durable task: [describe the goal]
